creationInfo.comment: INTERIM, HAND-MAINTAINED. This document is a placeholder for the SBOM GitHub's dependency-graph export generates for this repository, which is expected to replace it verbatim with no application change (RQ-BLD-014, ADR-ABT-001 DEC-ABT-007). Keep it accurate until that automation lands: the application discloses these licences to end users and has no other source for them.

packages.name: Xplorer
packages.comment: The subject of this document, not a dependency: listed in documentDescribes and therefore filtered out of the disclosure window (ADR-ABT-001 DEC-ABT-004).

packages.name: JUCE
packages.comment: Dual-licensed AGPLv3 / commercial. This build uses the open-source option, which for JUCE 8 is the AGPL -- NOT the GPL that JUCE 6/7 offered. Verified against the pinned 8.0.9 tag's own LICENSE.md.

packages.name: Catch2
packages.comment: Test-only dependency: linked into the test executables, not into the shipped application binary.

packages.name: Roboto Condensed
packages.comment: Embedded in the binary as XplorerAssets binary data so combo-box label widths are a property of the build (RQ-DSN-096, ADR-JUC-022). Licence text ships at juce/app/assets/RobotoCondensed-LICENSE.txt.
